# Boise Construction Co

> New residential construction in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley: custom homes, semi-custom homes, build-on-your-lot, shop homes, and the design and permitting that precede them. Design-build, founded 2020. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Design-build means one accountable team handles architectural design, engineering, estimating, Ada and Canyon County permitting, and construction under a single contract, backed by a written line-item scope before the foundation is poured. Budget ranges are produced by an on-site estimator from house geometry and specification level rather than a flat price per square foot, because the same 2,400 square feet costs very different money on a flat infill lot than on a sloped foothills parcel with a shared well. Ranges are planning estimates, not quotes; a firm proposal follows a site visit and a lot review.

## Services

- [Custom Home Building](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/custom-home-builder): A home drawn from a blank page around your lot, your budget, and how you actually live.
- [Semi-Custom Homes](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/semi-custom-homes): Start from a proven floor plan and personalize it, for a shorter timeline and a tighter budget range.
- [Build on Your Lot](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/build-on-your-lot): You already own the land. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction from there.
- [Design-Build](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/design-build): Design and construction under one contract, so the drawings and the budget never drift apart.
- [Home Design & Plans](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/home-plans-design): Architectural design, engineering, and permit-ready drawings for a home built to your site.
- [Lot Evaluation & Feasibility](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/lot-evaluation): Soils, utilities, access, setbacks, and slope reviewed before you commit to a parcel.
- [Shop Homes & Barndominiums](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/shop-homes-barndominiums): Post-frame and steel-framed homes that pair finished living space with real working shop square footage.
- [Energy-Efficient Homes](https://boiseconstruction.co/services/energy-efficient-homes): High-performance envelopes, tight ducts, and low operating costs verified by blower-door testing.
- [RE-10 / Inspection Repairs](https://boiseconstruction.co/re-10-repairs-boise): repairs from an Idaho RE-10 inspection response, completed and documented before closing, for real estate agents, buyers and sellers.
- [All Services](https://boiseconstruction.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boiseconstruction.co/areas).
